$comment: Reviewed baseline of every privileged object the Data API can reach. scripts/check-database-security.mjs fails when the live surface differs from this file, so widening it is a deliberate, reviewable act rather than an incidental line in a migration. Classifications: A = guarded (checks a capability of its own); B = converted to SECURITY INVOKER; C = internal/private (no grant to an exposed role); D = justifiably exempt, with the evidence in docs/POLYTOS-SECURITY-RISK-INVENTORY.md. Every entry needs a classification and a reason. Regenerate with --update after review; never to make a failure go away.

invoker_chain_exemptions.reason: Unreachable for anon, not merely ungranted. enforce_password_change is the PostgREST pre-request hook and its first statement returns when auth.uid() is null, which is always so for an anon request, so the current_session_context() call below it is never evaluated by this role. Granting it to anon would widen the surface to silence a finding about a call anon cannot make. Reviewed 2026-11-06; re-examine if that early return is ever removed.

agency_agent_line_obligations(p_float_ac.reason: Phase 4E agency read, decision OD-4. Returns the reasons an agent line cannot be closed yet: float still held, commission owed either way, transactions in flight, float trades pending. Reachable by `authenticated` on purpose — the screen reads it before offering the close button, so the rule has one implementation rather than a second one in the client. It discloses figures about one line of the caller's own branches and takes no lock. No capability check: this is advisory, and the act it advises on, close_agency_agent_line(), refuses without agency:providers.

approve_agency_cash_reconciliation(p_rec.reason: Phase 4C agency RPC. Certifies one cash count, optionally writing its variance off to 5950. Requires agency:reconcile to approve and agency:variance_adjustment as well to adjust, so a manager who miscounts cannot certify the miscount into the books; both refuse with 42501. Refuses the officer who recorded the count, one already closed, and one whose underlying balance has moved since the count was taken - a stale variance describes nothing. A variance is always recorded and only written off when asked for, with a reason.

approve_agency_float_reconciliation(p_re.reason: Phase 4C agency RPC. Certifies one float reconciliation, optionally writing its variance off to 5960. Requires agency:reconcile, and agency:variance_adjustment as well to adjust; both refuse with 42501. Refuses the officer who recorded the statement, one already closed, one whose float balance has moved since, and a write-off with no named provider statement. Its sign convention is the opposite of the cash one, so its two adjustment directions are written out separately.

authorise_agency_commission_exception(p_.reason: Phase 4B-S agency RPC, extended in Phase 4D. Authorises a commission figure that differs from what the provider's configured terms produce, recording the reason, the external evidence, the authorising officer and both pinned figures. Called with four arguments it also records the Owner's proposed amount, which the interface must do because the counter supplies none - without it the workflow was unreachable. Refuses any caller without agency:commission_exception with SQLSTATE 42501 before it reads the transaction; that capability is granted to owner_admin only. Refuses another branch's transaction via agency_locked_transaction(), a posted transaction, a negative figure, one above the principal, and one that does not actually differ. The audit row carries the figure before and after, so a change made after submission is never quiet.

create_agency_transaction(p_transaction_.reason: Phase 4B agency RPC. Records a draft agency transaction. Refuses a caller without agency:write with SQLSTATE 42501, before it reads a single argument, via agency_actor(). The operating branch is validated, never assumed: an officer assigned to a branch records at it and may name no other, an officer with none must name one, and the branch is checked with user_can_see_branch() and must be open. Phase 4B took it from the profile alone and fell back to the alphabetically first active branch for an officer who had none, which routed every Head Office transaction by a string comparison as soon as a second branch existed; 20261115001500 removed that fallback and made the branch an argument. Phase 4E also re-signed it for the fee mode and the provider timestamp, and each re-signing drops the previous signature so there is exactly one overload of the call that records money.

record_agency_cash_banking(p_bank_accoun.reason: Agency redesign RPC, client Rule 5. Records an agent banking collected physical cash into a company bank account, and posts nothing. Refuses a borrower session with SQLSTATE 42501 and the message “This action requires the agency:write capability.” before touching its arguments — measured by the behavioural probe (scripts/probe-definer-authorization.mjs), not inferred from its body. Also refuses a branch the caller cannot see with 42501, a closed branch, a future date, a non-positive amount, a charge at or above the amount, a missing deposit reference, a duplicate reference on the same bank account, and an inactive banker. The source cash account is looked up from the branch rather than taken as an argument, so a caller cannot name another branch's till.

record_agency_commission_payout(p_float_.reason: Phase 4E agency RPC. Records commission the provider paid into one agent line's float: Dr the line's 1320 account, Cr 1310, touching no income account because the income was recognised per transaction. Refuses a caller without agency:settlements with SQLSTATE 42501 via agency_actor(), a line the caller's branch cannot see, a closed line, more than that line's own outstanding receivable, and a missing or repeated provider reference. Takes the provider balance lock before the sorted account locks.

record_agency_commission_recovery(p_floa.reason: Phase 4E agency RPC, decision OD-10. Clears a commission recovery payable in 2230, either by deduction from the line's float or by offset against commission owed. Refuses a caller without agency:settlements with 42501 via agency_actor(), a line the caller's branch cannot see, an invented method, more than the line owes back, a float deduction the line cannot cover, and a missing or repeated reference.

record_agency_float_trade(p_kind text, p.reason: Phase 4E agency RPC, decision OD-7. Records a float purchase, sale or line-to-line transfer as pending and posts no journal, so it moves no balance. Refuses a caller without agency:float_trade with SQLSTATE 42501 via agency_actor(), a line the caller's branch cannot see, a transfer into a branch the caller does not administer with 42501, a closed line, a purchase into a line that is not active, a cross-provider or self transfer, a provider that holds no float, and a missing or repeated reference.

record_commission_settlement(p_provider_.reason: Phase 4C agency RPC. Records one remittance of accrued commission: Dr the branch receiving account, Cr 1310. Refuses a caller without agency:settlements with SQLSTATE 42501 via agency_actor(), before it reads any argument. Refuses a branch the caller cannot see with the same refusal as an unknown provider, so it discloses neither. Refuses an immediate-commission provider, a non-positive amount, a receiving account that is not the settling branch's own cash-at-hand or bank account, a duplicate provider statement reference, and more than the provider's outstanding receivable at that branch - read after a provider-and-branch advisory lock, so two concurrent settlements cannot both fit inside one balance. Never posts to 4510: the income was recognised at accrual.

return_agency_transaction(p_transaction_.reason: Phase 4B agency RPC. Returns a submitted transaction to draft with a reason. Refuses a caller without agency:verify with 42501, because judging a transaction wrong is the same authority as judging it right. Moves no money.

reverse_agency_cash_banking(p_banking_id.reason: Agency redesign RPC. Reverses a posted cash banking by contra entries; the original journal is never touched. Refuses a borrower session with SQLSTATE 42501 and the message “This action requires the agency:reverse capability.” before touching its arguments — measured by the behavioural probe. Also refuses a banking from another branch with 42501, a row that is not posted, an empty reason, a banking dated before today without agency:reverse_cross_day (42501), and a bank account that no longer holds what was banked. Idempotent on an already-reversed row.

reverse_agency_float_trade(p_trade_id uu.reason: Phase 4E agency RPC. Mirrors a posted float trade's journal leg for leg, asserting sufficiency on every asset the contra draws down, and keeps the original. Refuses a caller without agency:reverse with 42501 via agency_actor(), a trade from another branch, a trade that is not posted, and a blank reason.

reverse_agency_payable_settlement(p_sett.reason: Phase 4C agency RPC. Reverses one payable settlement by a contra entry, restoring the liability the remittance cleared. Requires agency:reverse rather than agency:settlements, because recording a remittance and undoing one are different authorities. Refuses a settlement at another branch with 42501 via agency_locked_payable_settlement(), refuses one already reversed, and requires a reason. The original row is annotated, never deleted.

reverse_agency_transaction(p_transaction.reason: Phase 4B agency RPC. Reverses a posted transaction by mirroring its journal. Refuses a caller without agency:reverse with 42501, and a prior-day reversal without agency:reverse_cross_day with 42501. Refuses a reversal whose deferred commission has already been settled.

reverse_commission_settlement(p_settleme.reason: Phase 4C agency RPC. Corrects one commission settlement recorded in error by a balanced contra - Dr 1310, Cr the receiving account - restoring the receivable and releasing any historical transaction the settlement was blocking from reversal. Requires agency:reverse with 42501, refuses a settlement at another branch via agency_locked_commission_settlement(), refuses one already corrected, requires a reason, and refuses if the receiving account no longer holds the money. Never deletes a settlement.

set_agency_agent_line_suspended(p_float_.reason: Phase 4E agency RPC, decision OD-4. Suspends an agent line or lifts a suspension, each with a required reason. Refuses a caller without agency:providers with 42501, a line the caller's branch cannot see, a closed line, and a no-op in either direction. Deliberately has no balance conditions: a suspension refused because the line holds float would be useless exactly when it is needed.

set_agency_provider_commission_source(p_.reason: Phase 4E agency RPC. Sets whether a provider's commission is computed from its configuration or reported per transaction. Refuses a caller without agency:providers with SQLSTATE 42501, refuses a provider that is already confirmed because its posted snapshots cite the basis in force, and refuses the reported source while a rate or fixed amount is configured. Audited.

set_agency_service_limit(p_transaction_t.reason: Phase 4E agency RPC, decision OD-11. Sets one service's maximum single transaction. Refuses a caller without agency:providers with SQLSTATE 42501 before it reads the type, so only the Owner configures a ceiling. Refuses NULL and zero, because the live-readiness guard treats an unstated ceiling as a reason not to post and this function exists to state one. Writes the before and after values and the Owner's reason to the audit log.

submit_agency_cash_reconciliation(p_cash.reason: Phase 4C agency RPC. Records one physical count of a branch till, covering agency and lending cash together because they share the drawer. Requires agency:reconcile with 42501. Refuses a branch the caller cannot see, refuses an agency float account by name and anything that is not cash at hand, refuses a negative count, a future date, and a second count of the same account on the same day. Snapshots the system balance under the account lock.

submit_agency_commission_reconciliation(.reason: Phase 4E agency RPC, decision OD-9. Records one provider statement period for one agent line with what the books recognised over the provider's own dates and what the statement reports. Posts no journal. Refuses a caller without agency:reconcile with SQLSTATE 42501 via agency_actor(), a line the caller's branch cannot see, a period that overlaps one already reconciled for that line, a period ending in the future or ending before it starts, a negative reported figure, and a missing or repeated statement reference. Takes the provider balance lock before the overlap check, which is what makes that check sound rather than racy.

submit_agency_float_reconciliation(p_flo.reason: Phase 4C agency RPC. Records one provider float till against the provider's statement balance, per till. Requires agency:reconcile with 42501 and refuses a till the caller's branch cannot see. Provider and branch come from the till's registration, never from the caller. Snapshots the system balance under the account lock.

verify_agency_cash_banking(p_banking_id.reason: Agency redesign RPC, client Rule 5. The one call that posts a cash banking: Dr the bank account for amount - charge, Dr 5080 for the charge, Cr the branch cash at hand for the full amount. Refuses a borrower session with SQLSTATE 42501 and the message “This action requires the agency:settlements capability.” before touching its arguments — measured by the behavioural probe. Also refuses a banking from another branch with 42501, the person who recorded it, a stale revision and insufficient cash. Idempotent on an already-posted row. Locks both ledger balances through lock_ledger_balances(), which sorts the account ids, before any balance is read.

verify_agency_float_trade(p_trade_id uui.reason: Phase 4E agency RPC, decision OD-7. The call that posts a pending float trade. Refuses a caller without agency:settlements with SQLSTATE 42501 via agency_actor(), a trade from another branch with 42501, the person who recorded it, a stale revision, and insufficient cash or float. Idempotent on an already-posted trade. Takes the provider balance lock — both branches in branch-id order on a cross-branch transfer — before the sorted account locks.

verify_agency_transaction(p_transaction_.reason: Phase 4B agency RPC, extended in Phase 4D. Verifies a submitted transaction and posts its journal. Refuses a caller without agency:verify with 42501, and refuses the submitter verifying their own with 42501 — which the verifier_not_submitter CHECK also refuses independently. The Phase 4D second argument is the revision the verifier reviewed: verification is refused when it is not the current one, and a call quoting no revision is refused once the figures changed after submission, so a manager cannot post a commission exception authorised behind a screen they had already loaded. Asserted in tests/db/agency-transaction-engine.test.ts and tests/db/agency-settlement.test.ts.

company_identity.reason: Reviewed exemption, 20261106000300. security_invoker = off is deliberate: company_settings requires settings:view to read, so invoker mode returns zero rows for every borrower and breaks receipts and the forced-password recovery screen — measured on a clean database, not assumed.
